title: Keep compact next materially smaller than its hard response ceiling
outcome: A compact next regression guard bounds per-row or relative payload economy independently of the 12 KiB protocol ceiling.
acceptance: parity coverage fails when compact next grows disproportionately to its returned row count

completion.summary: Added an independent compact-next economy regression: the realistic default 20-row fixture must retain all 20 rows while both JSON and text receipts stay at or below 8 KiB, below the 12 KiB hard ceiling.
